versions.content: In the state ETHSM_STATE_WAIT_OFFLINE, if ComM requests COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION for the corresponding network handle, EthSM shall set the controller mode to ETH_MODE_ACTIVE and call the API TcpIp_RequestComMode with TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE.

In the state ETHSM_STATE_WAIT_OFFLINE, if ComM re- quests COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION for the corresponding network handle, EthSM shall set the controller mode to ETH_MODE_ACTIVE and call the API TcpIp_Re- questComMode with TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE

Self transition WAIT_OFFLINE In the state ETHSM_STATE_ WAIT_OFFLINE, if ComM requests COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION for the corre- sponding network handle, EthSM shall set the controller mode to ETH_MODE_ACTIVE and call the API TcpIp_RequestComMode with TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE

Self transition WAIT_OFFLINE In the state ETHSM_STATE_ WAIT_OFFLINE, if ComM requests COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION for the corre- sponding network handle, EthSM shall set the controller mode to ETH_MODE_ACTIVE and call the API TcpIp_RequestComMode with TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE
